quality_note: From the 100% production stills: 24 textured cards tumble in with a believable motion blur, flop flat, slide and settle by 1.83 s; the box drops in from above the frame (no pop-in), lands on the pile at 2.98 s at 9.5 u/s, rebounds 0.059 u (restitution 0.2) and rests on the cards (base y 0.016, tilt 0.8 deg) with cards sticking out under it and no visible crush-through (deepest card/box overlap 0.009 u = 1.1 card thicknesses, for one 1/60 s step). loc_note: bake.mjs 143 + table-player.js 63 + timelines/drop.js 45 (the minimal adapter drop-min.js is 20); analyze.mjs 107 is QA tooling
deps_note: node_modules of the build-time bake tool (rapier3d-compat 0.21.0 incl. a 3.1 MB wasm inlined in a 4.3 MB module); shipped to the page: 0.39 MB table JSON (0.09 MB gzip) + 4.7 KB player
